blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — Iloilo and other parts of Western Visayas are among the agricultural areas affected by the ongoing El Niño phenomenon, which has resulted in P8.57 billion in nationwide agricultural losses and affected more than 288,000 farmers, according to the Department of Agriculture (DA). In its second El Niño situation report issued on October 21, the DA identified Iloilo among the provinces that have reported damage to plantations of rice, corn and high-value crops as the country braces for a strong to very strong El Niño that could persist until the first half of 2027.
